chunks.title: Inter-American Development Bank (IDB / IDB Invest) (IDB Group) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Inter-American Development Bank (IDB / IDB Invest) is a Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) headquartered in United States (Multilateral). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Founding member of Electrify Now Finance Coalition at COP31; signed LOI with BNDES & IBRD for Brazil industrial decarbonization. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: LOI toward $1B industrial decarbonization package in Brazil (with IBRD/CIF/BNDES) + Electrify Now Finance Coalition. Source verification: https://carbon-pulse.com/571307/.

chunks.title: IDB Group Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Inter-American Development Bank (IDB / IDB Invest) provides the following climate financing instruments: Sovereign Loan, Private-Sector Debt (IDB Invest), Equity, Blended Finance, Guarantee, Green/Blue Bonds. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 400,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Sovereign/Government, Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Municipality.

chunks.title: IDB Group Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Inter-American Development Bank (IDB / IDB Invest): Industrial Decarbonization, Electrification & Grid, Renewable Energy, Nature-Based Solutions & Forestry, Climate Adaptation & Resilience. Target geographic focus includes: Latin America, Caribbean, LAC, Americas. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: IDB Group Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete IDB Group's application form: LAC borrowing member country jurisdiction; IDB Environmental and Social Policy Framework (ESPF) & Paris Alignment; Development effectiveness & additionality scoring (DELTA); Audited financials & procurement transparency. Explicit exclusion rules: Thermal coal; Non-LAC project jurisdictions. Official application portal: https://www.iadb.org/en/who-we-are/topics/climate-change.

chunks.title: IDB Group Form Template: Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note
chunks.text: Inter-American Development Bank (IDB / IDB Invest) uses the 'Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note' workflow governed by Joint MDB Paris Alignment Methodology (BB1 Mitigation / BB2 Adaptation) & Environmental/Social Framework. Typical review timeline is 6–16 weeks (Concept Clearance -> Appraisal -> Board Approval). Form sections required: 1. Identification, 2. Strategic Alignment, 3. Financial Structuring, 4. Climate & Technical Rationale, 5. Safeguards & Governance, 6. Execution & Risks, 7. Executive Summary.
